title: docs(skills): objectstack-query gives the business question over records to objectstack-ask
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_
Fixes #35859
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:AI 助手通过连接向应用提业务问题(要一个数、一个排名、一个受管指标)时,「写查询」这份技能说明不再把这类问题揽到自己名下,而是写明交给「问数」技能;写在代码里的查询仍归「写查询」。
- 为什么做:属于「技能说明按任务开头」这条线的收尾。上一轮实测里两份技能同时安装时,「问数」十二次全中、「写查询」零次,可「写查询」的说明还在认领同一类问题,照它走会跳过受管指标的流程。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是助手在某类请求上少加载或多加载一份技能说明;只动说明文字和评测用例,不动任何运行代码,直接撤回本次合并即可复原。
- 要你做什么:本次改动落在对外发布的技能目录,需要你亲手合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md`, frontmatter `description` only.** The use-when drops "shaping a records query or aggregation sent over MCP". "Not for" now opens with "a business question answered from the app's records: a number, ranking or governed metric (objectstack-ask)". The other three exclusions keep their owners; the list is separated by semicolons because the first item carries commas, and "designing an API endpoint" is shortened to "an API endpoint".
- **`skills/objectstack-query/evals/triggers.json`, case 3: reworded, still `should_trigger: true`.**
- **`skills/objectstack-ask/evals/triggers.json`: case 7 added, `should_trigger: false`**, a metadata change asked over MCP (N3 of contract review 7040518746 on PR 35857). One case per line, as the file already is.
- **`content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`**: generator output of `gen:skill-docs`, one line. `skills/README.md` is byte-identical, because its table carries only the description's first sentence, which did not move.
- **`.changeset/35859-query-sends-business-question-to-ask.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

The boundary was written against what ask claims on `main`: its description takes "EVERY question answered from the app's records ... a number, a total ... a ranking, a breakdown, a trend or a list", its step 1 puts the governed metric first, and its "Do not use" sends "writing a query in application code" to objectstack-query. Query's own `rules/aggregation.md` already says the same ("Answering a user's question over MCP (`aggregate_records`), not writing a query in code: see **objectstack-ask**"). The query body teaches no MCP tool.

Description, before (435 characters):

> Write an ObjectQL query over ObjectStack records: filter, sort, paginate, aggregate by group, expand related records, full-text search. Use when writing a query in app code or a hook, choosing a pagination strategy, or shaping a records query or aggregation sent over MCP. Not for adding objects or fields (objectstack-data), a list view's filter or a dashboard dataset (objectstack-ui), or designing an API endpoint (objectstack-api).

After (477 characters):

> Write an ObjectQL query over ObjectStack records: filter, sort, paginate, aggregate by group, expand related records, full-text search. Use when writing a query in app code or a hook, or choosing a pagination strategy. Not for a business question answered from the app's records: a number, ranking or governed metric (objectstack-ask); adding objects or fields (objectstack-data); a list view's filter or a dashboard dataset (objectstack-ui); an API endpoint (objectstack-api).

Size readings (`skills/**` is a published catalog):

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` | 439 lines, 18404 bytes, 4596 tokens | 440 lines, 18448 bytes, 4607 tokens |
| all 14 `SKILL.md` | 4943 lines, 260339 bytes | 4944 lines, 260383 bytes |

Tokens are the ratchet's `ceil((bytes - 20) / 4)`. Whole PR: 18 added, 8 deleted, net 10 lines (budget 20).

Delta `d4661cccd3..abe343969a` (L1 C1, 7045169982): `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`, one table row. "Queries & reports over records" with "Show me the count of open tickets per priority, using an aggregation." becomes "Queries in app code" with "In a hook, write the ObjectQL aggregation that counts open tickets per priority." The old prompt was a business question, which is now ask's ground. The page has no objectstack-ask row, and none is added here. The Verification section below ran at `d4661cccd3`. The delta's own docs gates (doc-authoring, doc-anchors, route spelling, frontmatter) exit 0 at `abe343969a`.

## Evals

Query case 3, before:

> I'm connected to an ObjectStack environment over MCP. In one call, how many deals were won per sales region this quarter, and what is the average amount per region?

After (still expects query to load):

> In our ObjectStack app's server code, write one ObjectQL aggregation that returns, per sales region, the number of deals won this quarter and their average amount.

Why reworded and not flipped to `should_trigger: false`:

- Case 3 was the bundle's only aggregation positive (1 is filter and sort, 2 pagination, 4 search with an expanded relation, 5 filter and paging in Chinese). Flipping it would leave "aggregate by group", which the description still claims, with no trigger case. The reworded case keeps the same data question and moves it to where the description claims it: written in code.
- The MCP business question is already measured where it belongs. Ask case 1 is that prompt verbatim, as an ask positive.
- As a query negative the old prompt would say little today: a trigger turn installs one bundle, so it cannot show query yielding to ask. That reading belongs to the two-bundle turn the runner does not have yet (#35858).

New ask case 7 (expects ask to stay unloaded; the request is objectstack-data's):

> Over the ObjectStack MCP connection to our CRM, add a picklist field `region` (EMEA / APAC / Americas) to the `account` object.

It is the near miss that shares ask's MCP wording and falls under the first clause of ask's "Do not use" ("building or changing metadata"); the two existing negatives both cover the second clause.

No eval round was run in this PR. The re-measure of the #34769 round waits on #35858; this PR is meant to land before or with it.

## Acceptance notes

- **The description is 477 characters, above the 432 to 450 band of its six siblings.** Removing the MCP clause frees 53 characters and naming ask with the order's wording costs about 100. Reaching 450 needs 27 more, and every candidate cut takes something no trigger round in this PR would cover: "answered from the app's records" (the phrase that matches ask's own claim), "or choosing a pagination strategy" (query case 2), or the verbs and articles of the three older exclusions. No gate enforces a description length; the token ratchet holds with 940 of headroom. A 450-character variant is a one-line follow-up if the seat prefers the band.
- **N2 of contract review 7040518746** (the "Cross-skill routing" bullet in `skills/README.md` about wizards) reads as already settled on `main`: line 125 now sends a stepped form over one object to ui. Not touched here.
- `skills/README.md`'s hand-written routing section has no query and ask line; none was added, the file is outside this card's surface.
- The reference page renders use-when and not-for as one paragraph, so the new "Not for" shows there with its semicolons. Generator matter, unchanged.
